Shaco|sup.identity: Zone-control trickster. Backstab (passive): his attacks and thrown dagger deal more damage from behind. Deceive (Q) makes him invisible and teleports him a short distance (his first attack is empowered), Jack in the Box (W) places a hidden box that fears, then attacks nearby enemies, Two-Shiv Poison (E) passively poisons and slows, and can be thrown, and Hallucinate (R) creates a clone that fights and explodes into three mini-boxes when it dies.
Shaco|sup.playstyle: Trap support: he places Jack in the Boxes in bushes and on paths, fears engages and creates picks. He struggles against enchanters and solid lane supports (Lulu, Senna, Milio, Thresh).
Shaco|sup.early_game: Place Jack in the Boxes (W) in the lane's bushes and on escape paths: an enemy feared by several boxes is a kill for your ADC. Keep Deceive (Q) to escape or surprise. A thrown Two-Shiv Poison (E) finishes low-health enemies.
Shaco|sup.level_1: Paths vary: Jack in the Box (W) first is the most common, then Q → E paths. The most common max order is W > E > Q.
Shaco|sup.level_2: Two-Shiv Poison (E) or Deceive (Q). E to poke and finish, Q for mobility.
Shaco|sup.level_3: The missing ability. Set up boxes in the bushes before every trade.
Shaco|sup.level_6: Hallucinate: the clone fools your opponent and explodes into mini-boxes. Use it to escape, fake or add boxes mid-fight.
power_spikes: Level 2: several boxes placed in a bush.
First completed item: very dangerous boxes.
Shaco|sup.lane_plan: Control the bushes with your boxes and turn enemy engages to your advantage: they walk into your traps. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored).
Shaco|sup.trading: Basic trade: thrown E. All-in: lure your opponent into your boxes, Q to get behind them, attacks. Defense: boxes between your ADC and the enemy engage. Against supports who poke from range (Lulu, Senna), don't force it: your boxes get revealed or walked around.
threats: Lulu and Senna, the worst matchups.
Control Wards and reveals that uncover your boxes.
mistakes: Placing boxes in the open, where they're seen.
Using Deceive to attack and no longer being able to escape.
Leaving the lane too early (role quest penalty).

matchup_notes.Thresh: Place boxes where he lands after his hook.
matchup_notes.Lulu: She pokes and polymorphs you: play defensively with your boxes.
matchup_notes.Nautilus: Place boxes around your ADC: his engage ends up inside them.
matchup_notes.Morgana: Her abilities are slow: your boxes catch her off guard.
matchup_notes.Senna: She pokes you from far away: don't step up without your boxes in front of you.

Shaco|sup.mid_game: Place boxes around objectives before they spawn, and in the enemy jungle for picks.
Shaco|sup.late_game: Prepare the fight area with several boxes. Clone to fool the enemy, E to finish fleeing enemies.
Shaco|sup.ahead: Create picks with your boxes and help your jungler.
Shaco|sup.behind: Protect your ADC with boxes around them.
Shaco|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to trap the fight area so the enemy walks into your boxes.
Shaco|sup.final_tip: Stack several boxes in the same spot: the fears chain together and the enemy can't escape.
